content:
aisha: heads up - noticed negative invoice adjustments after today’s route_tag change. some events arriving with route_tags=null after enrich.

dan: can you paste a minimal event example?

aisha: tenant t-7421:
{event_id: e-22, route_tags: {tier: pro}, tokens: 210}
{event_id: e-23, route_tags: null, tokens: 40}
second event lost tags -> default ratecard applied -> preview vs ledger mismatch.

kevin: that matches the route_tag_v2 epoch flip i pushed. enrich falls back to null for unknown key name. aggregator treats null as its own bucket.

belinda: console preview shows token tallies lower than ledger for some tenants. preview uses canonicalized tags, ledger uses enriched attributes. transient v1/v2 split causing attribution drift.

metering-bot: alert: 1,432 events with missing route_tags in last 3h across 87 tenants.

kevin: short term: add aggregator compatibility layer that maps null -> last_seen_tag per tenant-session for 12h. avoids immediate invoice blips.

aisha: +backfill: reprocess the 3h window through enrichment, push to metering.replay with idempotency keys = event_id. ledger consumer will dedupe.

dan: risk of double-charge if replay and live mapping both write?

aisha: aggregator compatibility will not emit ledger writes, only affects preview and scoring. replay will be idempotent.

belinda: i can own backfill run. runbook: dry-run on dev, attach consumer to metering.replay, enable idempotent writes on ledger producer.

kevin: estimate: 15m to implement compat, 30-60m for backfill depending on throughput. i can pair with belinda.

deploy-bot: canary deploy aggregator-compat at 1765123470 (2 pods us-west).

aisha: monitoring: preview_vs_ledger_delta_pct and ratecard_assignment_histogram. rollback if delta > 1%.

belinda: adding temp console alert preview_ledger_delta_pct > 1% per tenant. also will notify affected tenants that previews may update after backfill.

dan: follow-ups: add contract tests for route_tag propagation across enrich->aggregator and emit a tag_propagation metric from enrichment (tags: route_version, region).

aisha: created GH-#1839 aggregator-compat, GH-#1840 backfill-runbook, GH-#1841 console-alerts, GH-#1842 enrichment-metrics. assigned owners.

belinda: will coordinate comms with support. please post progress here.

kevin: canary looks healthy so far. no preview divergence on canary pods.

aisha: proceeding with backfill dry-run on dev. will report results before prod replay.

dan: thanks all. add postmortem bullet: deploy gating for schema flips that touch pipeline-enriched attrs.
